flood.name: River flood
flood.tell: Snowmelt and rain have swollen the river. A flood is rolling toward our fields.
flood.caused: Clear-cut hills upstream in {cause} sent the water down faster.

cheap.label: Throw up a quick levee
cheap.effect: We stay dry, but the levee pushes the water downstream onto {target}.

green.label: Restore the wetlands
green.effect: Half the damage now, and the marsh soaks up every future flood. Nobody else gets our water.

flood.lesson: Levees don't remove floodwater; they move it. Wetlands store it.

drought.name: Drought
drought.tell: No rain for months. The wells are dropping and the wheat is wilting.

cheap.label: Pump the shared aquifer hard
cheap.effect: Our crops are saved, but {target} shares that aquifer and their wells run dry.

green.label: Store rainwater, plant hardy crops
green.effect: Half the damage now, and a cistern carries us through the next dry spell.

drought.lesson: Over-pumping a shared aquifer shifts a drought onto your neighbors.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.tell: Heat and dry wind have lit the forest. Fire is racing toward the town.

cheap.label: Clear-cut a wide firebreak
cheap.effect: The fire stops at the gap, but we felled a whole forest: +0.12°C for everyone.

green.label: Thin the woods with controlled burns
green.effect: Half the damage now, and a healthier forest burns less next time.

wildfire.lesson: Controlled burns remove dry fuel so wildfires burn cooler and slower.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.tell: Days of rain loosened the hillside. Mud is sliding toward the town.
landslide.caused: The bare slopes from {cause}'s lumber camps gave way first.

cheap.label: Pile up stone walls
cheap.effect: The walls hold, but the mud washes into the river and silts {target}'s fields.

green.label: Replant the slopes in terraces
green.effect: Half the damage now, and roots hold the soil for good.

landslide.lesson: Tree roots bind soil; clear-cut slopes slide.

smog.name: Smog
smog.tell: A brown haze has settled over the town. People and flocks are falling sick.
smog.caused: It blew in on the wind from {cause}'s kilns.

cheap.label: Build taller smokestacks
cheap.effect: Our air clears, but the smoke just blows farther, onto {target}.

green.label: Fit filters to the chimneys
green.effect: Half the damage now, and cleaner air from here on.

smog.lesson: Tall smokestacks move pollution downwind; filters remove it.

spill.name: River pollution
spill.tell: The river has turned grey with mine tailings. Our flocks won't drink it.
spill.caused: The runoff came down from {cause}'s mines.

cheap.label: Flush it on downstream
cheap.effect: Our stretch runs clear again, and {target} gets the sludge instead.

green.label: Dig settling ponds
green.effect: Half the damage now, and the ponds catch the runoff from now on.

spill.lesson: Pollution in a river is never gone; it moves to whoever lives downstream.

sea_rise.name: Storm surge
sea_rise.tell: A storm is driving the sea over the beach. Higher seas make every surge worse.

cheap.label: Pour a concrete seawall
cheap.effect: The wall holds, but it bounces the surge along the coast onto {target}.

green.label: Plant mangroves along the shore
green.effect: Half the damage now, and the mangroves break every future wave.

sea_rise.lesson: Hard seawalls deflect waves sideways; mangroves absorb them.

heatwave.name: Heatwave
heatwave.tell: The hottest summer anyone remembers. Streets bake and the herds are struggling.

cheap.label: Burn ore to run coolers
cheap.effect: We cool off today, and heat the whole planet: +0.1°C.

green.label: Plant shade trees, paint roofs white
green.effect: Half the damage now, and a cooler town every summer after.

heatwave.lesson: Trees and light roofs cool cities without burning more fuel.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.tell: An offshore earthquake has sent a series of waves toward our coast. Move away from the shore and follow the marked route to high ground.

cheap.label: Close our harbor and divert cargo
cheap.effect: Our stores are saved, but {target} must pay for emergency deliveries while our harbor is shut.

green.label: Build routes and refuges on high ground
green.effect: Half the damage now, and marked routes and safe storage reduce future losses.

tsunami.lesson: Tsunamis come in several waves. Move inland or uphill and return only when local officials say it is safe. Trees and seawalls cannot guarantee safety.
